title: iammojogo's Time Control
description: This mod is meant for servers but can be ran on clients also. It controls the time
body:
iammojogo's Time Control Mod

This mod controls teh time on the server. It gets into the server API and slowss down the time fully by 4x slower than default. 

Future plans may include individual time control speeds, like one of my 1.12.2 mods do with a gui. I just have to patch it over with new api and version code. 

🔧 COMPATIBILITY

Works with most server-side and client-side mods. Check compatiability and report if there are issues!

Requirements:

Minecraft 1.21.11 Forge 61+ (server installation needed)
